tldr: Pluto in the 1st house: power becomes personal through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
body:
With Pluto in the 1st house, this part of you intensifies identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life. Pluto describes power, pressure, truth, control, fear, attachment, and deep change. In practice, this brings attention to how you enter the room, respond first, take up space, and let the world meet you.

When this placement is supported, you can meet life with more self-trust and less need to explain yourself first. Pluto can become depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried.

When it is strained, you may become overly focused on how you are seen, or push your body past what it is trying to tell you. The harder pattern can show up as control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change.
gift: depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried expressed through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
challenge: control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change around identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
